segments.name: OrthoPediatrics
segments.description: Designs, develops and markets anatomically appropriate implants, instruments and specialized braces for children with orthopedic conditions.
segments.evidence: We have one operating and reportable segment, OrthoPediatrics, which designs, develops and markets anatomically appropriate specialized braces, implants and devices for children with orthopedic problems.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by hospitals, physicians and distributors for sales of its pediatric orthopedic implants, instruments, braces and O&P clinic services.
revenueModel.evidence: Product sales attributed to a country or region includes product sales to hospitals, physicians and distributors and is based on the final destination where the products are sold.

changes.text: In 2025, management decided to exit the Telos regulatory consulting business, writing off its goodwill and customer relationship intangibles.
changes.evidence: Management made the decision to exit its Telos regulatory consulting business, in the third quarter of 2025, resulting in a write-off of its entire goodwill balance.
